'''Arne''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When the number of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] increased after the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] began drilling for [[isotope-5]], Arne suspected that the work Arne and [[Max (Makeb)|Max]] were doing for the Hutts was causing the groundquakes and would lead to the world's destruction. To confirm this, Arne set up sensors to track the effects of the Hutts' drilling lasers on Makeb's core. Max agreed with Arne's suspicions, though grew concerned when Arne failed to respond to Max's messages.
